comment: Maps a displaceR binary version label to a published release asset.
The authoritative identity of a build is upstream_sha, not the DISPLACE
version string: include/version.h hardcodes VERSION and is not derived from
git tags, so many different upstream commits all report '1.6.6'.
Entries are added by hand from the step summary of the 'Build DISPLACE
binary' workflow. Bump 'default' only once a build has been smoke-tested;
users who pinned an older version keep working.
'builds' maps a glibc target to an asset. install_displace() picks the
newest build whose glibc requirement is <= the host's glibc.
'versions' is empty until the first release asset is published. Until then
install_displace() will tell the user to point DISPLACE_BINARY at a local
build, or to run the build workflow. See docs/roadmap.md.
